grammar.summary: 本课学习 surprising 数量表达与现在完成时表经历。

points.title: 现在完成时表持续服务
points.explanation: has been/has flown 表"到目前为止"的累积：Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.

examples.en: Captain Fawcett has flown passengers to many unusual places.
examples.cn: Fawcett 机长已经把乘客送到了许多不寻常的地方。

points.title: 数量表达的精确性
points.explanation: Once he landed on the roof of a block of flats. once = 有一次，叙事标志词。

examples.en: On another occasion, he landed in a deserted car park.
examples.cn: 还有一次，他降落在一个废弃的停车场。

exercises.q: He is too smart ___ the answer. (请使用合适的“find”填空)
